capabilities: Capture URLs via mobile share, clipboard, bookmarklet, or obsidian:// URI
Save one local Markdown note per URL with duplicate prevention
Add fixed, domain-derived, and folder-derived tags to clips
Collect new links in an inbox folder with optional Japanese or English presets
Search, tag, and move clips in history and library views
disambiguation: Despite the clipper name, it does not capture article text or images; it saves the URL only and never fetches the source page.
extras: Points to a separate NETWORK_AND_PRIVACY.md for the complete data flow, includes a full Japanese-language guide, is MIT licensed, and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Typical web clippers fetch page content, metadata and images, sending requests to every clipped site, which users who want link-only local capture cannot avoid.

relations.evidence: This is an independent plugin with its own release history.

summary: Privacy-first web clipper that saves shared URLs as local Markdown notes without ever requesting the source page.
